ctx.x: I read that you left school when you were 16 to lead a band. I read two different versions. I read one that you began your musical career by leading a band on an ocean liner, and then I read in another source that you played in bands on ocean liners and later had your own band. Which is right?

Well, actually the first band I had was quite a large band for that particular time, and it also happened to have been a non-union band. There was a restaurant on Broadway, upstairs, a Chinese-American restaurant, at the corner of 50th, where -- yes, 50th Street and Broadway, and they had gotten into some kind of a beef with the union, and somehow or other I got a band together and I called myself Fred Black.
